scripts.build: vite build && npm run copy-cdn && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.build:seo: vite build && npm run copy-cdn && npm run prerender
scripts.copy-cdn: mkdir -p dist/cdn && (cp ../src/widget/caty-widget.js dist/cdn/widget.js 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp ../src/widget/caty-commerce.js dist/cdn/commerce.js 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp ../src/widget/caty-leads-widget.js dist/cdn/leads.js 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp ../src/widget/caty-loader.js dist/cdn/loader.js 2>/dev/null || true)
scripts.build:full: npm run sync-blog && npm run build:seo
scripts.deploy: npm run build && aws s3 sync dist/ s3://catyai-landing --delete --exclude 'cdn/*' && aws s3 sync dist/cdn/ s3://catyai-landing/cdn/ && aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E3EB3UPK5D8B1L --paths '/*'
scripts.deploy:seo: npm run build:seo && aws s3 sync dist/ s3://catyai-landing --delete --exclude 'cdn/*' && aws s3 sync dist/cdn/ s3://catyai-landing/cdn/ && aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E3EB3UPK5D8B1L --paths '/*'
scripts.deploy:full: npm run sync-blog && npm run deploy:seo
